items.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
items.what_happened: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.
